fingerprint.structure: 1 slide: a centre 'feeling' image + a 2-line question title, ringed by 14 labelled cut-out items (4 top, 3 left, 3 right, 4 bottom). One ring item is the account's own app icon labelled with what it does + '(check bio)'
fingerprint.hook: mystery-recipe question: 'why does today feel <state>?' The ring is the answer, a checklist of the habits behind the good day, and the brand's app is slipped in as one of the habits (the bottom-left slot)
fingerprint.camera_motion: other:habit-ring-card. Designed card on a flat pale sage card: mixed-media cut-outs (stock photo objects, 2 meme cut-outs, flat black pictograms, one app icon) around a glowing centre figure. Static image
fingerprint.pacing: single image, about 30 words: a 5-word question, a handle line and 14 labels of 1 to 3 words
fingerprint.text_overlay: one thin neo-grotesk for everything (Helvetica Neue Light look), lowercase, black #111, tight negative tracking. Title 2 lines centred under the figure, about 6% of frame height per line. Labels about 3.3%, centred under each item, 1 to 2 lines. Handle in small grey under the title
fingerprint.audio: original sound by another account (music bed), no voiceover
fingerprint.arc: curiosity then recognition: the question makes you want the recipe, the ring gives it, and the in-joke items (a screaming creature for '0 noises', a meme guy for 'good workout') make it shareable. The brand item reads as just another habit; the caption points to the bio
fingerprint.measured: see measures.json visual slide 1: card #ebf1ea, sharpness 1852, clutter 7.7 (text edges count)

composition.balance: symmetric ring, centre column holds the figure and title

frame.safe_zones: the bottom row labels sit at 92 to 98%, under the TikTok caption area; the title is clear
frame.color_light: pale sage card, mostly natural-colour photo objects, black pictograms, one red sign; the centre glow is the only cold colour
frame.quality: deliberately mixed: sharp stock photos next to low-res meme crops and flat icons. Some cut-outs have rough edges
frame.origin_realism: collage of stock photos, meme stills and icon-font glyphs; no AI-polished look

other.what: a 'perfect day' habit checklist laid out as a ring of labelled objects around a question
other.carrier: the labels plus the object pictures; the title asks, the ring answers
other.layers: card, centre glow figure, 14 cut-outs, labels drawn as type
other.mix: stock photo objects, meme cut-outs, icon glyphs and one app icon on purpose, so it reads as a hand-made collage
other.humour: the meme items and the deadpan numbers ('0 noises', '7h+ sleep')
other.product: the account's app icon as one habit, bottom-left, label ends '(check bio)'
other.repeatable: swap the identity's day: the habits, the state in the question, the centre figure

product: the account's own app icon in the bottom-left ring slot, labelled with what it does + '(check bio)'; caption repeats 'check bio'
caption: one short line that teases the answer and sends to the bio, then 5 hashtags
